title: SB2517 (2020 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Hawaii) (gun-policy Stage 5, Hawaii); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Hawaii text (Introduced, official copy, https://data.capitol.hawaii.gov/sessions/session2020/bills/SB2517_.HTM; sha256 d2f039c0df2a4dc73bb1eb383daaccd54edb697d0c5e75ea958092fae43b3046)
provenance.note: Introduced text. The Act strikes the existing rule that one rifle/shotgun permit covers purchases for one year. Quoted sentences in Section 2 also contain struck words ("or"); they are quoted here without them. No votes on file.

operative_text:
SECTION 2 (HRS 134-2(e)): Permits issued to acquire any pistol, revolver, rifle, or shotgun shall be void unless used within ten days after the date of issue. Permits to acquire a pistol, revolver, rifle, or shotgun shall require a separate application and permit for each transaction.
SECTION 3 (HRS 463-10.5(e)): Before beginning employment as a guard or in a guard capacity, in addition to the classroom instruction required by this section, guards and individuals acting in a guard capacity who carry a firearm or other weapon, including but not limited to an electric gun as defined in section 134-1, while on-duty in a guard capacity shall possess a valid license to carry a firearm issued by county police pursuant to procedures established by each county police department under section 134-9 and shall satisfy the safety and suitability requirements of section 134-9(b).
